prompts.riverbank-v3: Production modular asset sheet for a side-scrolling 2D Thai Lanna fantasy RPG. Exactly THREE equal columns in ONE row, 3 separate complete cutout environment assets on genuine transparent background. All assets horizontal and low, side elevation not isometric, same warm hand-painted polished style as terracotta-roof Lanna houses. No text, no labels, no people, no scenery backdrop. Generous transparent padding and clear separation between cells. LEFT CELL: a long low stone river embankment face, about 4:1 width-to-height, horizontally flat warm limestone coping at top, hand-laid irregular rounded granite blocks beneath, shaded crevices, subtle green moss and small trailing vines along lower edge, no wooden vertical posts. Its left and right ends must join when repeated horizontally, continuous level coping, no protruding objects at ends. MIDDLE CELL: one small local boat landing in side elevation, low weathered teak deck on TWO short braced wooden piers, a short stairway descending onto it from its LEFT end, sturdy worn planks with carved edge, mooring rope, no tall railing and no long forest of posts; self-contained small dock. RIGHT CELL: a low clump of natural riverbank plants, graceful reeds, broad water-lily leaves, a few pink lotus flowers and smooth wet grey stones, a tiny driftwood branch, no water rectangle or ground backdrop. Crisp texture and natural irregular shapes, restrained elegant details, no flat geometric placeholder shapes.
prompts.river-water-v3: Production seamless water surface texture for a side-scrolling Thai fantasy riverfront RPG. Wide 3:1 panorama around 2172x724, fills entire image with calm close-range turquoise and jade-green river WATER ONLY. Detailed hand-painted small natural horizontal ripples and gentle overlapping wavelets, subtle warm gold reflections between cool blue-green ripples, clear water with soft depth and scattered tiny glints. Sophisticated polished game environment painting, subtle varied organic texture, no blur or smeared horizontal streaks, no exaggerated repeating lines, no solid flat fill. Low contrast to keep game characters readable. Horizontal edges should join seamlessly when tiled. NO shoreline, NO mountains, NO sky, NO buildings, NO boats, NO animals, NO lily pads, NO text, NO borders. Opaque background, all water.
